gpu_monitor.accounting: sum full-run manifest elapsed_seconds plus sequential evaluation command wall time
gpu_monitor.action: terminate active evaluation and fail closed at the hard budget

hard_stops: Any frozen execution file or scientific asset hash mismatch.
Any incomplete upstream training block or non-final checkpoint.
Any incomplete predeclared evaluation block presented as complete.
Any non-finite output, coverage mismatch, or 240 GPU-hour budget hit.
Any outcome-based change to model, seed, condition, prompt, detector, tunnel, frame, or width inclusion.

queue.result_blinding: queue checks process exit and coverage markers only; it does not select by performance
queue.resume: completed model/fold/frame artifacts are hash/identity checked and skipped; incomplete atomic units may be recomputed

result_access_at_freeze: One fixed-final training checkpoint (nafnet/base_seed0) existed and the next training run was active. No checkpoint had been evaluated and no C009 endpoint result existed. This v2 closes omissions found in a result-blind audit; it does not alter any model, seed, cohort, degradation, or endpoint gate.

lpips.input: grayscale replicated to RGB, scaled to [-1,1]

matched_sensitivity_burden.burden: restored minus degraded false-positive pixel rate
matched_sensitivity_burden.gate: parent-within-tunnel macro bootstrap 95% CI upper bound <= 0
matched_sensitivity_burden.reference: degraded-input recall at the frozen threshold 0.5, per detector, tunnel, parent, and seed pairing
matched_sensitivity_burden.restored_operating_point: highest 4096-bin score threshold attaining at least the reference recall

scientific_addendum.overshoot_metric: At clean Sobel-edge pixels above the 75th percentile, sample clean and candidate at +/-1.5 px along the clean gradient normal and report the 95th percentile excursion outside the clean endpoint envelope.
scientific_addendum.reason: The parent contract fixed WP8 scope but did not spell out the controlled degradation or the implementation binding for LPIPS and frozen RAW traces. These details are fixed here before any C009 endpoint result.

wp6_raw_baseline_reuse.rule: reuse only the frozen raw detector endpoint; all 18 C009 restored endpoints are recomputed

wp8_controlled_degradation.implementation: scipy gaussian_filter reflect then deterministic Gaussian noise and uint8 round/clip
wp8_controlled_degradation.trace_rule: reuse the frozen RAW v2 orientation and stored trace for both controlled-degraded and restored variants

scope: all OOD operators finite and bounded
frozen RAW trace reuse on an actual width ROI
